blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima on Monday expressed concern that the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) is attempting to muzzle other authorities from speaking on the West Philippine Sea (WPS) issue. On Sunday, the DFA underscored that diplomacy is the Philippines’ main course of action in managing tensions with other nations, as it called recent comments by public officials on China “regrettable” and reaffirming that the president is the chief architect of the nation’s foreign policy The DFA’s comments follow weeks of sharp public exchanges between Philippine officials and the Chinese Embassy over Beijing’s sweeping maritime […]...
